providers.title: Common supports
providers.scope: If ||alpha v + beta w|| = alpha + beta for unit v, w and alpha, beta > 0, then v and w share a support; a functional of norm at most 1 equal to 1 at a positive combination of unit vectors equals 1 on their hull.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Radial contact
providers.scope: For ||c|| < 1 each ray c + R_+ v, v in S_X, meets the sphere in exactly one point c + rho(v) v, with 1 - ||c|| <= rho <= 1 + ||c|| and rho continuous.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The Mazur–Ulam theorem
providers.scope: A surjective isometry between real normed spaces is affine.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Reduction to the defect
providers.scope: If a surjective sphere isometry has defect 0, its radial extension is a surjective real-linear isometry, the only linear extension.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Limits along an ultrafilter
providers.scope: Bounded real sequences have unique limits along a free ultrafilter on N; these limits are linear, monotone, commute with continuous functions and extend ordinary limits.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Attainment of the defect
providers.scope: A surjective sphere isometry of positive defect M between normed spaces yields one between Banach spaces (completed ultrapowers) with defect bound M attained at some (x_0, y, t), 0 < t < 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Kuratowski's measure of noncompactness
providers.scope: chi is unchanged by closure and by (closed) convex hulls; nested closed sets with chi -> 0 in a Banach space have nonempty compact intersection.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Schauder's fixed-point theorem
providers.scope: A continuous self-map of a nonempty compact convex subset of a normed space has a fixed point (from Brouwer's theorem).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Darbo's fixed-point theorem
providers.scope: A continuous self-map of a nonempty closed bounded convex subset of a Banach space with chi(g(H)) <= gamma chi(H), gamma < 1, has a fixed point.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Propagation along common supports
providers.scope: If v is extremal and l shares a support with the return direction g(v), then l is extremal; g preserves the extremal set.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: An invariant convex set
providers.scope: There is a nonempty closed convex set of extremal directions preserved by the return map.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Contraction of noncompactness
providers.scope: On the invariant set, chi(g(H)) <= (1 - M/(1+t))^2 chi(H).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Aligned chords
providers.scope: An attained positive defect gives chords x = ty + pv, z = ty - rv and f(x) = tb + sw, f(z) = tb - uw with s - p = r - u = M and p + r = s + u = ||x - z|| <= 2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A secant estimate
providers.scope: For supports phi at v + theta y: eps/p <= phi(v) <= K, with K <= 1 - B if B <= eps and K <= B if B > eps.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Long half-chords are impossible
providers.scope: In a chord configuration A = p/d and B = u/d are at most eps = 1 - t.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: No chord configuration exists
providers.scope: Convexity of the norm along the two chord directions contradicts the preserved distance between y and z.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Tingley's problem (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Every surjective isometry between unit spheres of nonzero real Banach spaces extends uniquely to a surjective real-linear isometry, the radial map.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Normed spaces
providers.scope: The same holds for nonzero real normed spaces.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
